equipment_type: Air conditioner BACnet gateway (1 indoor unit)
applies_to: Fujitsu residential and VRF indoor units, connected with the supplied AC cable.
summary: A one-unit Intesis interface for Fujitsu residential and VRF indoor units that speaks BACnet MS/TP or Modbus RTU (DIP-selectable). It exposes 38 fixed objects including left/right louvres, economy mode, room freeze protection, occupancy logic and a virtual-temperature function for a BMS room sensor.
notes: Protocol (BACnet MS/TP or Modbus RTU) is selected on a DIP switch; BACnet MS/TP is the default.
The number of fan speeds is set on SW1 (four by default), which changes the FanSpeed state list in use.
Virtual temperature is not available when a Fujitsu communication accessory is used between the gateway and the unit.
Occupancy setpoint AVs and OnTimeCounter are writable on this model.
Units shown as °C follow the °C/°F DIP switch.

source.title: IN485FGL001I000 Gateway - Fujitsu Residential and VRF Systems to BACnet MS/TP and Modbus RTU - User Manual

integration.summary: Connect the gateway to the indoor unit (supplied AC connection cable), set the BACnet network on its DIP switches, then write the _command objects (on/off, mode, setpoint, fan) and read back the matching _status objects. One gateway serves one indoor unit (or one remote-controller group), so give each gateway its own MAC address and device instance.

minimum_points.name: SetPoint_status
minimum_points.why: Setpoint the unit is really using

integration.enable: No enable point or BMS/local switch is documented; the gateway accepts BACnet commands as soon as it is communicating with the unit. A wired remote controller can still be used in parallel; MO 5 RemoteControllerProhibit_command locks it.
integration.remote_sensors: Write the BMS setpoint to AO 0 Setpoint_command and the BMS room temperature to AO 1 RoomTemperature_command. Once both are valid the Virtual Temperature function starts and the setpoint sent to the unit becomes unit temperature - (BMS temperature - BMS setpoint). BI 14 VirtualTempActive shows it is running and AI 17 UserSetPoint_status shows the BMS setpoint. At start-up AO 1 is UNRELIABLE_OTHER until the first write.
setup: BACnet MS/TP only; the EIA-485 port has DIP switches for the 120-ohm terminator and bus biasing.
MS/TP MAC address 0-127 is set on DIP switches; baud rate is DIP-selectable (9600-115200) with autobaud as the default, which matches the baud rate of another MS/TP device running a fixed rate.
Default device instance 246000. In automatic mode the instance is 246000 + the MAC address; writing Object_Identifier from BACnet switches to manual mode until a factory reset.
DIP switch SW1 position 5 off selects BACnet MS/TP (default); on selects Modbus RTU.
gotchas: Every function has a separate _command (AO/BO/MO, commandable) and _status (AI/BI/MI) object; write the command, read the status.
Temperatures follow the Celsius/Fahrenheit DIP switch; the BACnet Units property changes with it.

The Occupancy MV and its four AVs drive built-in logic that sets mode, setpoint and on/off; leave Occupancy at 3 (Disabled) unless you use it, and any manual on/off, mode or setpoint change cancels it.
Set the number of fan speeds on SW1 P1-P2 (four by default) to suit the unit; it sets which FanSpeed states are used.
